body: Abandon Every Idea about Enlightenment In order to be successful in your quest for Freedom, it is imperative that you unconditionally abandon every idea that you have about Enlightenment. As long as you think that Enlightenment is something that can be understood by the mind, the cycle of blindly perpetuat¬ ing your own ignorance will never cease. 4 6 No Idea Q: Would this be an accurate description of Enlightenment: accepting the whole universe as yourself and loving the universe as yourself? A: No, it would not. Having no idea about the universe and having no idea about yourself. That would be more like it. 4 7
